name: Can I convert an appliance from natural gas to propane?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert an appliance from natural gas to propane?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many natural gas appliances can be converted to run on propane, but it requires specific conversion kits and professional expertise. This typically involves replacing gas orifices and adjusting the regulator to suit propane's different pressure and BTU characteristics. It's important to consult your appliance's manufacturer specifications and have a qualified technician perform the conversion to ensure safety and proper operation. Attempting a DIY conversion can be dangerous and void warranties, highlighting the need for professional plumbing solutions in your Las Vegas home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting an appliance from natural gas to propane is possible but requires professional installation of a conversion kit and adjustments to ensure safety and proper function.
